description: ctxward keeps chosen environment variables out of Claude's context. Every hook runs `ctxward hook <event>` through scripts/ctxward-launch. See DESIGN.md, 'How the hooks fit together'.

PostToolUse.description: Hide values in every tool result (all tools). A hit while the session is in auto mode also leaves the redaction flag.

PostToolUseFailure.description: A failure's text cannot be rewritten, so only warn the model if it contained a protected value.

PreToolUse.description: One check before a tool runs. All tools: deny anything that reaches the config directory. Write, Edit, NotebookEdit: refuse content that contains a redaction placeholder. Bash: make the command always exit 0 and print its real exit code as text, because a failing command's output skips the hook that hides secrets. Monitor: pipe the stream through `ctxward filter`, which hides secrets line by line. Bash after a redaction in auto mode: send the call to the permission prompt.

PermissionRequest.description: Only after a redaction in auto mode, and only once: on the next Bash command, approve a harmless echo instead of it and switch the session to manual mode. At any other time this does nothing.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Block a prompt that contains a protected value or hidden name (a prompt cannot be rewritten).

SessionStart.description: Shown to the user only, never added to the model's context: whether protection is active (counts only, never names), so a missing or broken config is not silent.
